title: 2.5 Viruses
description: Viral structure, replication cycles, host dependence and virus-related concepts. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? A non-cellular infectious agent that requires a host cell
Which term matches this description? The protein coat that surrounds the genetic material of a virus
Which term matches this description? A lipid layer surrounding the capsid of some viruses
Which term matches this description? The DNA or RNA that makes up the viral genome
Which term matches this description? A complete infectious virus particle outside a cell
Which term matches this description? A living cell that a virus infects and uses for replication
Which term matches this description? The process by which a virus makes copies of itself
Which term matches this description? A viral cycle that ends with destruction of the host cell
Which term matches this description? A viral cycle in which viral DNA integrates into the host genome
Which term matches this description? Viral DNA that is integrated into a bacterial chromosome
Which term matches this description? A virus that specifically infects bacterial cells
Which term matches this description? An RNA virus that copies its genome into DNA
Which term matches this description? An enzyme that makes DNA from an RNA template
Which term matches this description? A surface protein that helps a virus attach to host cells
Which term matches this description? The time between infection and the appearance of symptoms
Which term matches this description? A state in which a virus remains dormant in the host
Which term matches this description? A modified virus used to deliver genes into cells
Which term matches this description? A small infectious RNA molecule without a protein coat
Which term matches this description? An infectious misfolded protein that can cause disease
Which term matches this description? A medicine that inhibits the replication of viruses
